evidence: Composer core@0.1.0 supplies native WPF layout primitives used by WPF UI recipes and composite blocks.
WPF UI TextBlock exposes theme-aware appearance, wrapping, alignment, size, and weight.
EditorialCard provides a wide source-backed media composition; narrow and standalone images can be composed with the core layout pack.
SymbolIcon uses the source-backed WPF UI SymbolRegular vocabulary.
WPF UI Button exposes content, appearance, command, alignment, and icon composition.
Card supplies a theme-aware generic surface; EditorialCard supplies a source-backed wide media surface.
NavigationView and TabView expose source-backed item and content relationships.
AutoSuggestBox and NumberBox provide direct text-search and numeric input surfaces.
ToggleSwitch exposes checked state and TabView exposes source-backed item selection.
DataGrid exposes source-backed columns, items binding, and empty-state composition.
Theme-aware text appearances and progress controls cover inline status and activity feedback without requiring a host service.
The pack provides both linear bounded progress and compact ring progress.

capabilities.reason: Directly composable controls cannot preserve the required host or presenter behavior.
evidence: WPF UI ContentDialog and Snackbar require host or presenter behavior and were excluded from the directly composable pack until a behavior-integration contract exists.
Media requires an accessible automation name and generated elements retain stable Composer element names and automation identifiers.
Typed checked, numeric, and navigation state properties remain observable and mutable through WPF runtime tools.
The pack pins WPF UI packages and loads ThemesDictionary followed by ControlsDictionary in declared order.
